In this video: In March 2020, Breonna Taylor was in her apartment at 1 AM when police crashed in on a no-knock warrant, shooting her dead. After months of demands for justice, a grand jury finally was empaneled to assess charges for the cops involved, and yesterday, the jury declined to charge any of them with murder or even manslaughter. Clearly this is evidence that the capitalist injustice system is unwilling to confront the police state that has been set up under the guise of the War on Drugs/War on Terror in recent decades.

Black Lives Matter dot org official statement is here: https://blacklivesmatter.com/statement-by-black-lives-matter-global-network-foundation-in-response-to-grand-jury-verdict-in-the-breonna-taylor-case/
